title: ArabicBridge
description: ArabicBridge fixes Arabic text compatibility between Minecraft Java and Bedrock players. It converts Arabic messages into a Java-readable format while preserving proper native rendering on Bedrock, enabling seamless cross-platform Arabic communication.
body:
# ArabicBridge

Fix Arabic chat between **Java** and **Bedrock** players on servers using **GeyserMC** and **Floodgate**.

ArabicBridge automatically formats Arabic messages so they appear readable on both platforms, without mods, resource packs, or client-side setup.

## Features

* Fixes broken or unreadable Arabic chat.
* Works with GeyserMC + Floodgate.
* Keeps Arabic readable on both Java and Bedrock.
* Lightweight and plug-and-play.

## Requirements

* Bukkit, Spigot, or Paper
* GeyserMC
* Floodgate

## Installation

1. Drop the plugin JAR into your `plugins` folder.
2. Make sure GeyserMC and Floodgate are installed.
3. Restart the server.

## Compatibility

* Bukkit
* Spigot
* Paper
